title: Timeline of Ashoka Pillar relocation
subject: History
caption: Timeline of key events in the relocation of the Ashoka Pillar.
altText: A left‑to‑right flowchart showing eight chronological nodes: the pillar’s erection around 250 BCE by Ashoka, its association with the Mauryan Empire, its original location at Sarnath, the reign of Firuz Shah Tughlaq (1309‑1388 CE), the 1356 CE move to Delhi, placement near the Qutub Minar, a 19th‑century relocation within Delhi, and its current location in the National Museum, New Delhi.
